description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to a buyUrl (trackingTag null until enrolled). ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. OpenAPI: resolveProduct.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, se, de. REQUIRED.

name: resolve_product
title: Resolve buy link
